bicycle-crossing: Yellow diamond with a black bicycle drawn with two outlined wheels.
crossroad: Yellow diamond with two thick black lines forming a plus sign.
curb-blue: Gray roadway beside a blue painted curb.
curb-green: Gray roadway beside a green painted curb.
curb-red: Gray roadway beside a red painted curb.
curb-white: Gray roadway beside a white painted curb.
curb-yellow: Gray roadway beside a yellow painted curb.
curve: Yellow diamond with a black arrow curving to one side as it rises.
deer-crossing: Yellow diamond with a black drawing of a four-legged animal with antlers.
divided-highway: Yellow diamond with two opposing black arrows. The space between them widens toward a black divider at the top.
divided-highway-ends: Yellow diamond with two opposing black arrows. The space between them narrows above a black divider at the bottom.
do-not-enter: Red circle with a white horizontal bar and the words DO NOT above it and ENTER below it.
four-way-stop: Red octagon reading STOP, with a separate red plaque below it reading ALL WAY in white.
hill-ahead: Yellow diamond showing a truck angled down to the left above a solid slope.
hospital: Blue rectangle with a large white letter H.
hospital-right: Blue rectangle with a large white H and a white arrow pointing right.
keep-right: White rectangle reading KEEP RIGHT, with a black arrow curving around the right of a black obstruction.
lane-ends: Yellow diamond with two black lines. The left line stays straight and the right line bends inward.
merge: Yellow diamond with a straight upward arrow. A separate black line curves toward it from the right.
no-left-turn: White rectangle with a black arrow bending left under a red circle and diagonal slash.
no-passing: White rectangle with the black words DO, NOT, and PASS stacked vertically.
no-right-turn: White rectangle with a black arrow bending right under a red circle and diagonal slash.
no-turn-on-red: White rectangle with the black words NO TURN ON RED above a small red circle.
no-u-turn: White rectangle with a black arrow looping back down under a red circle and diagonal slash.
one-way: Black rectangle with a white arrow pointing right and the words ONE WAY.
pedestrian-crossing: Yellow diamond with the black symbol of one person walking.
railroad: Yellow circle with a black X and an R on each side.
right-turn-only: White rectangle with a black arrow bending right and the black word ONLY below it.
roundabout: Yellow diamond with three black arrows curving counterclockwise around the center.
school-crossing: Fluorescent yellow-green five-sided sign with two black figures walking above a horizontal line.
side-road: Yellow diamond with one vertical black line and a short branch from the right.
signal-ahead: Yellow diamond with a black vertical box containing red, yellow, and green lights.
slippery: Yellow diamond with a black car above two wavy track marks.
speed-limit: White rectangle reading SPEED LIMIT 35 in black.
stop-ahead: Yellow diamond with a black upward arrow above a plain red octagon edged in white.
stop: Red octagon with the word STOP in white.
t-intersection: Yellow diamond with a thick black T.
two-way-traffic: Yellow diamond with a black arrow pointing down on the left and up on the right.
winding-road: Yellow diamond with one upward black arrow bending back and forth.
work-zone: Orange diamond with a black figure holding a shovel beside a pile.
wrong-way: Red rectangle with the white words WRONG WAY on two lines.
yield: Downward-pointing white triangle with a red border and the red word YIELD.
